title: Single cell transcriptomics of index-sorted dendritic cell precursors from human peripheral blood
description: The transcriptomes of single cells from human perpheral blood were investigated at single cell level, with the aim to reconstruct the development of human dendritic cell (DC) lineages. Overall design: 176 single cell transcriptomes were sampled from blood pre-DC populations and isolated into 96 well plates via fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS).
